summary: Wide gravel rest area on a bend, bush behind, cars already parked.
reasons: Large gravel pull-off clear of the lane
Bush behind, quarry across the road

best_section.where: Gravel rest area on the inside of the bend, at the ring

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto forest; quarry on the far side. No buildings within 100 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide gravel apron opens straight onto the road edge; room for many vehicles well off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Passing traffic on the bend, but the van stands off the lane.
drivers.convention: Informal rest area; three or four vehicles parked in both images.

flags: Steep: about 5.7% mean, 15% max in DEM
Mapped gates 232 m away, not on the only access
sun_shade: Open gravel in the sun; trees shade the north and west edge in the afternoon.
